Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, "For Lunch Meeting".

from decimal import Decimal, getcontext

# Base prices from email thread

    'as_moore@gmail.com': ('Ashley Moore', Decimal('19')),
    'corwils@gmail.com': ('Cory Wilson', Decimal('28')),
    'cheweber@gmail.com': ('Cheryl Martinez', Decimal('19')),
    'morgan-harrison@gmail.com': ('Morgan Burton', Decimal('29')),
    'ta.weav@gmail.com': ('Tammy Weaver', Decimal('22')),
    'alexwhite@gmail.com': ('Alex White', Decimal('25')),
}

sum_base = sum(price for _, price in receivers_base.values())
tip_total = (Decimal('0.20') * sum_base)
delivery_fee = Decimal('11')
num_people = 7  # 1 me + 6 coworkers
shared_piece = (tip_total + delivery_fee) / Decimal(num_people)

print('sum_base', sum_base)
print('tip_total', tip_total)
print('delivery_fee', delivery_fee)
print('shared_piece_exact', shared_piece)

# Venmo amount should be in dollars; round each request amount to cents but keep equal shared piece.
shared_piece_cents = shared_piece.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
print('shared_piece_cents', shared_piece_cents)

request_amounts = {}
for email,(name,base) in receivers_base.items():
    amt = (base + shared_piece_cents).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
    request_amounts[email] = (name, base, amt)

# display table
for email,(name,base,amt) in request_amounts.items():
    print(email, name, 'base', base, 'request_amt', amt)

print('total_requested_excluding_me', sum(v[2] for v in request_amounts.values()))
print('expected_total_food_base', sum_base)
print('expected_total_tip_delivery', tip_total+delivery_fee)
print('me_shared_piece_if_equal_cents', shared_piece_cents)
